about Rocky. if you're back on your feet in a few months and still want to go home, fine, I'll drive the trailer up myself. but don't decide it this week, sitting in a garage full of garbage bags. nobody should make a call like that in the worst week of their year.

and you can't quit. your songs are the best thing about this band and the three of us all know it. the notebooks are pulp but the songs aren't gone, they're in your head and a fair few are stuck in ours.
